theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpo_pf_boundary
theorems.statement: ∀ (lpush : ∀ (N N' k : ℕ), (Euclid N → Euclid N') → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) k), (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (Λ' : ℝ) (F : Euclid N → Euclid N') (Fs : ℕ → Euclid N → Euclid N') (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) k) (ηs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (Fs j)) → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ X.support, ‖fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x‖ ≤ Λ') → TendstoUniformlyOn Fs F atTop X.support → (∀ j, ∃ W : Set (Euclid N), IsOpen W ∧ X.support ⊆ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (ηs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') k) (Fs j x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x)) → Tendsto (fun j => X (ηs j)) atTop (𝓝 (lpush N N' k F X ω))) → ∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F : Euclid N → Euclid N') (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)), LipschitzWith Λ F → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → X.boundary.mass < ∞ → (lpush N N' (k + 1) F X).boundary = lpush N N' k F X.boundary
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
